proof:
Source: steps 6–8 of the supplied proof of c1_critical_slices_null (Simon Ch. 2, p. 66, the consequence of (6.3) stated before 6.4, book/chapter-02.txt lines 1476–1478; Simon gives no proof), i.e. the Borel majorants, the covering estimate and Fatou's lemma, abstracted from the subcube covers to arbitrary countable covers. The only change is that the Borel majorant uses a measurable hull of G(T_i ∩ S) instead of the compactness of G(Q ∩ C); hence no topological or measurability hypothesis on S or G is needed.
1. (Covers at scales ε_j.) For j ∈ ℕ put ε_j := (j+1)⁻¹ ∈ (0, ∞). Then ε_j → 0 as j → ∞ (ENNReal.tendsto_inv_nat_nhds_zero composed with j ↦ j + 1). Apply the hypothesis with ε = ε_j and choose a countable index type ι_j and sets T_{j,i} (i ∈ ι_j) with (a) S ⊆ ⋃_i T_{j,i}, (b) diam T_{j,i} ≤ ε_j for all i, (c) Σ_i (diam T_{j,i})^k · Lᵐ(G(T_{j,i} ∩ S)) ≤ ε_j.
2. (Measurable hulls.) For all j, i let A_{j,i} := toMeasurable(Lᵐ, G(T_{j,i} ∩ S)). It is a measurable set, G(T_{j,i} ∩ S) ⊆ A_{j,i}, and Lᵐ(A_{j,i}) = Lᵐ(G(T_{j,i} ∩ S)) (Mathlib measurableSet_toMeasurable, subset_toMeasurable, measure_toMeasurable).
3. (Majorants.) Define g_j : ℝᵐ → [0, ∞] by g_j(y) := Σ_{i ∈ ι_j} (diam T_{j,i})^k · 1_{A_{j,i}}(y). Each summand is a constant times the indicator of a measurable set, hence measurable, and a countable sum of measurable [0, ∞]-valued functions is measurable (Measurable.tsum, formerly Measurable.ennreal_tsum); so g_j is measurable. By the monotone convergence theorem for countable sums (lintegral_tsum), ∫⁻ c·1_A = c·Lᵐ(A) for measurable A (lintegral_const_mul, lintegral_indicator_one), and step 2,
   ∫ g_j dLᵐ = Σ_i (diam T_{j,i})^k · Lᵐ(A_{j,i}) = Σ_i (diam T_{j,i})^k · Lᵐ(G(T_{j,i} ∩ S)) ≤ ε_j by 1(c).
4. (Fatou.) Let h(y) := liminf_{j→∞} g_j(y); h is measurable as a liminf of a sequence of measurable functions (Measurable.liminf). By Fatou's lemma (lintegral_liminf_le) and step 3, ∫ h dLᵐ ≤ liminf_j ∫ g_j dLᵐ ≤ liminf_j ε_j = 0. Hence ∫ h dLᵐ = 0 and, h being measurable, h(y) = 0 for Lᵐ-a.e. y (lintegral_eq_zero_iff).
5. (Covering estimate.) Fix y with h(y) = 0. For all j, i put t_{j,i} := T_{j,i} ∩ (S ∩ G⁻¹{y}). Then diam t_{j,i} ≤ diam T_{j,i} ≤ ε_j for all j, i, and S ∩ G⁻¹{y} ⊆ ⋃_i t_{j,i} for every j, since every u ∈ S lies in some T_{j,i} by 1(a). The covering bound for the Hausdorff measure with countable covers whose diameters are bounded by r_j → 0 (Mathlib Measure.hausdorffMeasure_le_liminf_tsum with d = k, r_j = ε_j and the filter atTop) gives
   μH[k](S ∩ G⁻¹{y}) ≤ liminf_j Σ_i (diam t_{j,i})^k
   (in Mathlib the power is the real power (diam)^(k:ℝ), which equals the natural power, ENNReal.rpow_natCast).
6. (Comparison with g_j.) For all j, i: (diam t_{j,i})^k ≤ (diam T_{j,i})^k · 1_{A_{j,i}}(y). Indeed, if t_{j,i} = ∅ then diam t_{j,i} = 0 and 0^k = 0 because k > 0. If t_{j,i} contains a point u, then u ∈ T_{j,i} ∩ S and G(u) = y, so y ∈ G(T_{j,i} ∩ S) ⊆ A_{j,i}; the indicator equals 1 and (diam t_{j,i})^k ≤ (diam T_{j,i})^k by monotonicity of the diameter and of x ↦ x^k on [0, ∞]. Summing over i (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum) gives Σ_i (diam t_{j,i})^k ≤ g_j(y) for every j, and monotonicity of liminf (liminf_le_liminf) with step 5 gives μH[k](S ∩ G⁻¹{y}) ≤ liminf_j g_j(y) = h(y) = 0.
7. (Conclusion.) By definition μHE[k] = c_k · μH[k] with the constant c_k := addHaarScalarFactor(volume on ℝᵏ, μH[k]) (euclideanHausdorffMeasure_def), so μHE[k](S ∩ G⁻¹{y}) = c_k · 0 = 0. This holds for every y with h(y) = 0, hence for Lᵐ-a.e. y ∈ ℝᵐ. ∎
key_steps: Choose countable covers (T_{j,i})_i of S at scales ε_j = (j+1)⁻¹ → 0 with Σ_i (diam T_{j,i})^k Lᵐ(G(T_{j,i}∩S)) ≤ ε_j.
Measurable hulls A_{j,i} ⊇ G(T_{j,i}∩S) of equal measure give measurable majorants g_j = Σ_i (diam T_{j,i})^k 1_{A_{j,i}} with ∫ g_j ≤ ε_j.
Fatou's lemma gives ∫ liminf_j g_j = 0, so liminf_j g_j(y) = 0 for Lᵐ-a.e. y.
For such y the covers T_{j,i} ∩ S ∩ G⁻¹{y} and hausdorffMeasure_le_liminf_tsum give μH[k](S∩G⁻¹{y}) ≤ liminf_j g_j(y) = 0 (empty pieces contribute 0^k = 0 as k > 0).
μHE[k] = c_k·μH[k], so Hᵏ(S∩G⁻¹{y}) = 0 for Lᵐ-a.e. y.
